Salvamont is the official app for the National Mountain Rescue Association of Romania, provided together with Vodafone Romania.
You have just installed the most complete mountain guide for Romania: browse updated information about 51 mountains, 600 marked hiking trails, 150 chalets and 180 ski slopes around the country.

With it you can plan ahead your mountain journeys, receive the most important warnings and easily find weather forecasts, hiking trails, contacts, accomodations and location for chalets and ski slopes.

Most importantly, the SOS section offers you smartphone location tracking, helping you to instantly notify Salvamont Call Centre about your route, coordinates, altitude and even your remaining battery.

The service is recommended to all who travel on bad weather or venture into unknown areas. This way the Salvamont team can track all tourists traveling in risk areas and, in case anyone calls for support, identify location accuratelly increasing rescue chances.
At user's reques, the application will try to locate the smartphone position using GPS or mobile network antenna triangulation, sending the data to Salvamont Call Centre.
Location tracking can be activated for longer periods of time, like an entire hiking session, allowing Salvamont to monitor your position the entire duration.

During winter season, Salvamont offers ski slope conditions report, measured daily by Salvamont teams around the country:
- snow thickness and it's evolution
- skiing conditions
- ski slopes images, offered by Jurnalul National
- mountain maps
- live weather and 3-day forecasts, offered by ANM
- length, difference, difficulty, schedules, transportation, night skiing, snow cannons and other facilities

All Vodafone Romania local customers using mobile internet benefit of free data traffic inside the application.
